text: Most of the week's 51 pull requests in BCApps changed behaviour, and none were marked as breaking. Posting and cost fixes lead. #14490 stops repeated partial return postings from reusing the first credit memo, #14413 converts quantities for a different unit of measure, and #13112 corrects item charge handling when a posted purchase invoice is canceled. #14450, #12153, #14186 and #13562 address production order and inventory valuation problems. #14507 and #13854 make Set G/L Account No. on VAT Entries respect filters. #14429 and #14225 fix Get Return Shipment Lines for non-inventory items. Localization fixes include #13015 for Mexico, #14297 for Germany, #13613 for Australia and #14139 for Czech compensations. The Expense Agent had the most feature work: #14528 adds a Lost Receipt option, #14136 adds per diem rounding, #14492 registers the capability as generally available, and #13673 exposes the active approver. #14405 renumbers three codeunits to avoid collisions. Payables Agent fixes are #14527 and #14442. Custom agents gain Markdown instructions in #13831 and timeline task creation in #13811. Partners get new expense events in #14346. #14471 changes a field type to BigInteger.

issues: Gaps in coverage: some fixes that change behaviour are left out, such as warehouse picks and shipments (#13331, #14013, #14240) and price list duplicates (#13786). Some features are also left out: #13732, #14480, #13813. This is acceptable for a summary.
#14405 and #14346 are flagged as not changing behaviour. The paragraph does not say they do, so it is consistent with the flags.
#14139 is filed under localization. It also changes the events partners can use (separate customer and vendor lookup events). This is fine where it sits.
